Leaflet-Compatible Color Palette Functions (color_numeric, color_bin, color_quantile, color_factor, label_format)

Source: R/scales.R
color_numeric.Rd

Drop-in equivalents of leaflet::colorNumeric(), leaflet::colorBin(), leaflet::colorQuantile(), leaflet::colorFactor(), and leaflet::labelFormat(). While glmap natively supports passing color = ~col, palette = "viridis" directly to layer functions without creating manual palette functions, these functions allow existing leaflet scripts and Shiny apps that construct pal <- colorNumeric(...) and call addPolygons(fillColor = ~pal(val)) |> addLegend(pal = pal, values = ~val) to run with zero code modifications.

Usage

color_numeric(
  palette,
  domain,
  na.color = "#808080",
  alpha = FALSE,
  reverse = FALSE
)

color_bin(
  palette,
  domain,
  bins = 7,
  pretty = TRUE,
  na.color = "#808080",
  alpha = FALSE,
  reverse = FALSE,
  right = FALSE
)

color_quantile(
  palette,
  domain,
  n = 4,
  probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = n + 1),
  na.color = "#808080",
  alpha = FALSE,
  reverse = FALSE,
  right = FALSE
)

color_factor(
  palette,
  domain = NULL,
  levels = NULL,
  ordered = FALSE,
  na.color = "#808080",
  alpha = FALSE,
  reverse = FALSE
)

label_format(
  prefix = "",
  suffix = "",
  between = " - ",
  digits = 3,
  big.mark = ",",
  transform = identity
)

colorNumeric(
  palette,
  domain,
  na.color = "#808080",
  alpha = FALSE,
  reverse = FALSE
)

colorBin(
  palette,
  domain,
  bins = 7,
  pretty = TRUE,
  na.color = "#808080",
  alpha = FALSE,
  reverse = FALSE,
  right = FALSE
)

colorQuantile(
  palette,
  domain,
  n = 4,
  probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = n + 1),
  na.color = "#808080",
  alpha = FALSE,
  reverse = FALSE,
  right = FALSE
)

colorFactor(
  palette,
  domain = NULL,
  levels = NULL,
  ordered = FALSE,
  na.color = "#808080",
  alpha = FALSE,
  reverse = FALSE
)

labelFormat(
  prefix = "",
  suffix = "",
  between = " - ",
  digits = 3,
  big.mark = ",",
  transform = identity
)

Arguments

palette

Color palette name ("viridis", "YlOrRd", "Blues", "RdYlBu", etc.), character vector of hex/named colors, or palette function.

domain

Numeric or categorical vector (or range) defining the input domain.

na.color

Color string used for NA values (default "#808080").

alpha

Logical; whether to preserve alpha channel (default FALSE).

reverse

Logical; whether to reverse the color ramp (default FALSE).

bins

Numeric vector of explicit cut breaks or single integer number of bins (default 7).

pretty

Logical; whether to use pretty() breaks when bins is a single number (default TRUE).

right

Logical; whether intervals are closed on the right (default FALSE).

n

Number of equal-count quantile bins (default 4).

probs

Optional numeric vector of quantile probabilities in [0, 1].

levels

Optional character vector of factor levels.

ordered

Logical; whether levels are ordered (default FALSE).

prefix, suffix

Optional string prefix/suffix for legend labels.

between

Separator string between bin bounds (default " - ").

digits

Number of significant digits for numeric legend formatting.

big.mark

Thousands separator (default ",").

transform

Optional function applied to numeric values before formatting.

Value

A palette function carrying "paletteType", "colorArgs", and "domain" attributes compatible with both glmap::add_legend() and leaflet::addLegend().
